purpose: Detect directed control changes rather than one untyped boundary, motivated by brief merged native possessions.
train: 156 input features, local TCN with 3 state and 7 event heads (none plus 6 directed changes); 1200 updates, seed2030; 75% boundary-centered crops; segment-weighted state CE plus .5 inverse-sqrt-count event CE.
decoder: Only event peaks >.15, >=.4s apart per type, create instantaneous Viterbi transition bonuses of 1/2/4 times type probability. No frame-specific rules.
selection: Highest selection spellF1 with macro>=baseline-.002; freeze then evaluate selected only on fold2; adopt if both game means improve and macro>=baseline-.002.
limitation: Historically used external games; new-round held-game confirmation, not untouched final test.
